name: HyperXosist Agent Use
description: Machine-readable entrypoint for AI agents that generate advanced X search URLs with HyperXosist noise reduction, research templates, and validation.

agentConversionSummary.problemSolved: Builds noise-reduced, operator-rich X/Twitter search queries and search URLs for agents that need high-signal candidate feedback discovery.
agentConversionSummary.whenToUse: Use before Signal-to-Fix when an agent needs to source relevant X/Twitter feedback with spam, promo, and engagement-bait reduction. Prefer applyTemplate('signal_to_fix') or product_feedback for feedback pipelines.
agentConversionSummary.inputToSend: keywords, anyOf (OR group), exactPhrase, fromUser, toUser, mentionUser, hashtags, urlDomain, excludeWords, date filters, minFaves/minRetweets/minReplies, language, media/content filters, rawOperators, mode, and noise settings. Optional templateId via client-side applyTemplate before POST.
agentConversionSummary.expectedOutput: A paid query/search result from the x402 endpoint, including an X search query or search URL suitable for gathering candidate feedback.
agentConversionSummary.paidAction: POST the same query input to the configured x402 payment endpoint.
agentConversionSummary.on402: Read x402-payment.json and paymentOptionsEndpoint, complete the x402 payment, then retry the same POST with payment proof.

payment.instruction: AI agents must POST input to the configured x402 endpoint and complete payment before using generated search URLs. Human browser use remains available through index.html. Local preview via buildQuery/buildSearchUrl is free but must not be used as a payment bypass for automated agent workflows.

complementaryPositioning.hyperxosist: Agent-facing execution/query layer with x402 payment flow and advanced X operators.
complementaryPositioning.signalToFix: Feedback/noise -> actionable issue, PR spec, and implementation prompt.
complementaryPositioning.whyTogether: HyperXosist produces cleaner paid search execution for candidate feedback; Signal-to-Fix turns the resulting feedback into keep-only implementation artifacts.

anyOf.description: OR group. String may use commas or ' OR '. Becomes (a OR b OR c).

lang.description: Use empty string for global search, or X language codes such as en, ja, es, fr, de, ko, zh.

rawOperators.description: Raw X operator fragment appended to the query.

exampleTemplate.note: Client-side: const input = HyperXosistAgent.applyTemplate('signal_to_fix', { keywords: 'my-product' }); then POST buildPaidRequest(input).body

linkedServices.handoff: Use paid HyperXosist query generation to collect candidate X/Twitter feedback, then analyze it in Signal-to-Fix. Signal-to-Fix downstream outputs use only decision === "keep" items.
